events.name: Los Angeles Lakers at New Orleans Pelicans

notes.headline: NBA Play-In - West - 7th Place vs 8th Place

headlines.description: — LeBron James, Anthony Davis and their supporting cast have the Los Angeles Lakers looking like a tougher out in the playoffs than they appeared to be just a few weeks earlier.
headlines.shortLinkText: LeBron James and the Lakers beat Pelicans in play-in, earn a playoff rematch with the Nuggets

events.name: Golden State Warriors at Sacramento Kings

notes.headline: NBA Play-In - West - 9th Place vs 10th Place

headlines.description: — The chants of “Light the Beam!” started midway through the fourth quarter as the Sacramento Kings kept piling on the Golden State Warriors.
headlines.shortLinkText: The Kings eliminate the Warriors from play-in tournament with 118-94 win
